app.title: Clj.rs – a Clojure dialect implemented in Rust
app.description: A Clojure dialect written in Rust that compiles to native code, offering a fast and type‑safe alternative to the JVM implementation.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and build the compiler
Compile and run the provided hello‑world program, verifying output
Measure compilation time and binary size against the JVM Clojure compiler
Run the REPL, evaluate a small macro, and check the result
